ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sorloo uses the camera to scan barcodes, photograph your meals and, if you wish, take your progress photos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sorloo only accesses your photos when you pick a meal or progress photo.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Sorloo reads your steps, weigh-ins and workouts to track your step goal, your weight curve and tick off your sessions.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Sorloo writes nothing to Health: the app only reads your steps, weigh-ins and workouts for your tracking.
